service.en: Abu Dhabi Green Visa for freelancers
service.ar: التأشيرة الخضراء في أبوظبي للعاملين لحسابهم الخاص

about: Five-year residence for freelancers with a MOHRE freelance permit.
note: Requirements read from the official ADDED long-term residency page on the checked date. The visa itself is applied for through ICP, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Hold a freelance permit from MOHRE
Hold at least a bachelor's degree or a specialised diploma
Self-employment income of at least AED 360,000 a year for the last two years, or proof of financial solvency for the stay
documents: Proof of the income or of financial solvency
channels: ADDED contact line 800555, 8 am to 3 pm, or contact@tamm.abudhabi
